model.title: Credit Access and Inclusion Act of 2026
model.meta: Financial Services Committee · Rep. Young Kim (R-CA)

summary.text: The bill would expand what positive financial information can be reported to credit agencies, allowing reports on whether consumers pay their rent, utilities, and telecommunications bills on time. It would also protect consumers in payment plans with energy companies from being marked as delinquent, and it would require a government study on how this expanded reporting affects consumers' credit access and financial well-being.
